statement: At least one attack on a commercial vessel occurs in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO or US CENTCOM publicly reports at least one attack on a commercial vessel in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden occurring between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No attack on a commercial vessel occurs in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.

statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged at its meeting concluding on 2026-09-16.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement released for the September 2026 meeting announces no change to the federal funds target range; FALSE if it announces any increase or decrease.
failure_condition: The September 2026 FOMC statement announces an increase or decrease in the federal funds target range.

statement: North Korea conducts at least one ballistic missile launch between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff or the Japan Ministry of Defense reports at least one North Korean ballistic missile launch occurring between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No North Korean ballistic missile launch occurs between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.

statement: A vulnerability affecting VMware vCenter Server is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog contains an entry naming VMware vCenter Server with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The CISA KEV catalog contains no VMware vCenter Server entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.

statement: NYMEX front-month WTI crude futures settle at or above 90.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the official NYMEX settlement price for front-month WTI crude is 90.00 USD or higher on any trading day between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: Every NYMEX front-month WTI settlement between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30 is below 90.00 USD.

statement: The United States and Iran both announce a ceasefire, truce, or framework agreement halting hostilities between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP report that both governments announced a ceasefire, truce, or framework agreement between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No ceasefire, truce, or framework agreement between the United States and Iran is announced by both governments between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-31.

statement: A Microsoft Defender vulnerability is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry whose product field names Microsoft Defender with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The CISA KEV catalog contains no Microsoft Defender entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.

statement: USGS records an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 300 km of USGS event us6000tjl2 with origin time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS earthquake catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 300 km of event us6000tjl2 with origin time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12 UTC.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog lists no event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 300 km of event us6000tjl2 with origin time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12 UTC.

statement: Russian authorities seize or detain a commercial vessel flagged in or owned by an EU or UK entity between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP report Russian seizure or detention of an EU or UK flagged or owned commercial vessel occurring between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12.
failure_condition: No seizure or detention by Russian authorities of an EU or UK flagged or owned commercial vessel occurs between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-12.

statement: The government of Iraq announces a signed agreement or decree providing for disarmament or integration of Iran-aligned militia groups between 2026-08-13 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or Al Jazeera report an Iraqi government announcement of a signed disarmament or integration agreement or decree covering Iran-aligned militias between 2026-08-13 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No signed agreement or decree on disarmament or integration of Iran-aligned militias is announced by the Iraqi government between 2026-08-13 and 2026-11-30.
